<div class="card-body">
'''Lone Pilot''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">単独航行</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロット（か専属パイロット）がどこかの星系カードにおいて単独で戦闘を防衛している時に使う。戦闘運命数を１回引くことができる。パイロットが「モッティ」ならば、戦闘運命数を２回引くこと。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-257o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">デス・スターの周囲を単独で哨戒していたタイ・ファイターは、突如ミレニアム・ファルコンと遭遇した。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Solo Flight.

'''Card text:''' Use when a pilot or permanent pilot is defending alone in a battle at a system. You may draw one battle destiny. If the pilot is Motti, draw two battle destinies.

'''Lore:''' A TIE fighter patrolling alone around the Death Star suddenly encountered the Millennium Falcon.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Lone Pilot]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
